label: an approximate reconstruction from the cited claims, not the experiment's geometry
subsystem: barrel time-of-flight (AC-LGAD strip staves): the 144 tilted staves as silicon sensor strips, as in the ePIC simulation geometry 26.11.0, status development

quantities.name: staves
quantities.definition: barrel TOF staves (volumes tagged stave) in the expanded IR
quantities.derivation: BarrelTOF_Module_nphi = 144 (eic:C36); the PDR draft states 144 tilted staves (eic:C37, Tier 2)

independence.result: a design count, not a simulation output; the PDR draft states 144 staves independently of the geometry file; it does not depend on the disputed radius and z range

quantities.name: sensor_x0
quantities.definition: x/X0 of one stave's silicon sensor for a geantino crossing it along its normal (stave 0)
quantities.derivation: 0.35 mm (BarrelTOF_Sensor_thickness, eic:C36) / 93.70 mm (PDG silicon at 2.329 g/cm3, eic:C26)

sources.source: PDG Atomic and Nuclear Properties (2025 web edition), eic:S15 via claim eic:C26
sources.value: silicon: density 2.329 g/cm3, radiation length 21.82 g/cm2 (9.370 cm)

independence.result: independent of Geant4: the thickness and density are design values written as input to the ePIC simulation (release 26.11.0), not outputs of it, and the radiation length is PDG's tabulation; the reference is not a Geant4 output. Geant4 computes radiation lengths with the same Tsai formula, so agreement validates the geometry and the material definition, not Geant4's radiation-length physics. The sensor is G4_Si (2.33 g/cm3, 0.04 % above PDG's 2.329); the geometry's 'Silicon' material was not traced.

negative_control.change: 0.30 mm sensors (the forward TOF's thickness) instead of 0.35 mm

approximations: each stave is one continuous silicon strip 30.0 mm wide, 0.35 mm thick and 2600 mm long (z from -1125 to +1475 mm, eic:C36): the 2 cm sensors, their overlaps and dead spaces, the two half staves, Kapton, carbon foam, cooling and services are not modelled, so the stave is not the 3 % X0 stave of the PDR requirement

the strip centre sits at the layout radius 646 mm, tilted by 18 degrees about the beam axis by the case's ring convention; the geometry's sensor offset inside the 60 mm module and the sign of its phi_tilt are not reproduced

the radius and z range are disputed (geometry 64.6 cm and -112.5 to +147.5 cm, eic:C36; PDR draft around 65 cm and 63 cm, and -117.5 to +171.5 cm, eic:C37): the case uses the geometry (Tier 2, development) for construction only; no quantity depends on them
the 0.35 mm silicon is the geometry's sensor volume, not the active thickness (likely 50 um per the PDR); the forward TOF is not part of this case
status: comparison with cited values: not validated
